name: single-cell perturbation network inference benchmark
description: A large-scale benchmark assessing network inference methods using single-cell perturbation data to measure accuracy under perturbations.
evaluation_method: AUPR (area under precision–recall) and AUROC; secondary: F1 scores and precision/recall at thresholds
typical_sota_score: variable (AUPR often reported in the ~0.1–0.6 range depending on dataset and task)
reputation: Growing benchmark in computational biology for assessing methods that infer regulatory networks from single-cell perturbation data; increasingly cited within that community.
notes: Non-LLM, biologically noisy data: subject to batch effects, limited perturbation coverage, and uncertain ground-truth networks; performance is highly dataset-dependent.
